The present bail application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime/FIR No. 37/2024, under Sections 498A/323/504/506/364 I.P.C., P.S. Ashiyana, District Lucknow East.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the complainant.

After arguing at some length, upon objection being raised by the learned counsel for the respondents, learned counsel for the applicants submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the bail applciation with liberty to file a regular bail application.

Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file Hriday Narayan Pandey And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197428553/
